एष 3. एष, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 3. इष्), seeking;
(अस्), m. running or hastening towards; (according to
Sāy. एषे is an inf. fr. rt. इ, ‘to go’) seeking; wish,
election; (आ), f. wish.
—एषैष्य (एष-एष्˚), अस्,
आ, अम्, Ved. to be sought, desirable.

एषण, अस्, आ, अम्, seeking; (अस्), m. an iron
arrow; (अम्), n. driving, pressing; seeking; probing;
wish, desire; (आ), f. seeking, wish, desire, begging,
solicitation, request; (ई), f. an iron or steel probe; a
goldsmith's balance, assay scales.
एषणिन्, ई, इनी, इ, seeking, striving.

एषणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be desired, desirable; to
be aimed at; (at the end of a compound) relating to
medical examination.

एषवीर एष-वीर, अस्, m. designation of a
despised Brāhmaṇic family.
